_about: H5a blind Pidgin set (docs/phases/16_post_launch_roadmap.md H5a step 1). Authored 2026-10-18 and committed BEFORE any H5a measurement, in the same commit as the router rule and arm parameters below. Expected refs were read from the v2 Act clause headings and text (build_corpus('v2')), never from a retrieval run. 10 pidgin_dev rows select; 10 pidgin_test rows are read ONCE, after the dev gate. Caveat: written by a non-native speaker from general Nigerian Pidgin usage; a native-speaker read is recommended before this set is reused beyond H5a.

_frozen_before_measurement.router: The static arm applies iff the question contains at least one of these Pidgin marker tokens (lower-cased, whole-token match): dey, wetin, abeg, wey, dem, una, sabi, comot, pikin, wahala, abi, oya, wan, sef, sha, gree, oga, na, di. Otherwise the query takes the shipping path unchanged.
_frozen_before_measurement.arm: F0 arm D verbatim (docs/phases/15 F0 amendment): per doc, RRF 1/(60+r_tfidf) + 1/(60+r_static) over each doc's whole index; TF-IDF side = the shipping effective query (hand map + OOV bridge); static side = the RAW user query embedded with potion-base-8M; top 4 per doc, 12 total; ties by TF-IDF rank; each Hit keeps its TF-IDF score; refusal is the shipping decision verbatim.
_frozen_before_measurement.gate: Pidgin-dev net >= +2 (questions up minus down on recall_strict vs shipping); then Pidgin-test read once, net >= +1; the router fires on 0 frozen-10/dev/test/test2 questions, or those questions do not drop; 0/212 by identity; serving numpy-only, artifact <= 40 MB.
